purpose: Independent deterministic acceptance addendum for the seven semantic blockers, eight atomic blockers, and single-use claim blocker recorded at the WP5 boundary.

test_design.input_format: strict JSON with duplicate keys and non-finite numbers rejected
test_design.metric: Exact agreement with every declared positive and negative decision
test_design.direction: All positives pass and all negatives fail closed
test_design.threshold: 38 of 38 assurance tests pass with zero failures, errors, or skips; original 43 and RV2 30 also remain exact pass
test_design.uncertainty_method: Deterministic exact comparison; no statistical uncertainty
test_design.fixture_isolation: All state mutation, concurrency, symlink, release-report, and lost-response fixtures use temporary directories and never modify product, canonical state, upstream frozen artifacts, or final reports
test_design.freeze_rule: Criteria, fixtures, inputs, directions, thresholds, commands, and exclusions freeze before implementation outcomes are observed; demonstrated harness defects require an explicit design correction record

public_atomic_contract.diagnostic_boundary: preflight never authorizes consequential action and never emits an executable token
public_atomic_contract.reservation_boundary: reserve-action atomically persists bounded capacity and returns a non-executable reservation token with authorizes_consequential_action false
public_atomic_contract.claim_boundary: claim-action is the sole first-use authorization transition; one successful atomic claim changes reserved to claimed and returns authorizes_consequential_action true exactly once
public_atomic_contract.single_use: Every exact replay, second claim, concurrent loser, expired claim, divergent claim, stale CAS, or claim after narrowed authority returns no new authorization and does not execute
public_atomic_contract.reconciliation_boundary: reconcile-action charges actual or conservative use once, is exact-replay idempotent, preserves recovery_required, and never authorizes execution

criteria.claim: Critical/high risk acceptance is exact, temporally valid, waivable, and never accepts safety controls through legacy, generic, or revoked approval.
positive_cases: A structured waivable high finding with exact current risk_accept_finding approval passes.
negative_cases: Legacy critical-safety acceptance uses a generic approval.
Legacy critical-safety acceptance uses a revoked approval.
Structured high acceptance omits waivability.
Structured high acceptance omits finding revision.

criteria.claim: Critical/high resolution requires existing current independent evidence and exact real-artifact coverage.
positive_cases: Current independent evidence with real artifact coverage resolves.
negative_cases: Structured resolution evidence is authored by remediation owner.
Structured coverage names a nonexistent artifact.
Legacy high resolution cites nonexistent evidence.

criteria.claim: R1 completion requires truthful independent Review gate semantics and independently authored gate evidence.
positive_cases: Current Validation and independent Review gates with independent evidence permit completion.
negative_cases: Review record is advisory or failing while independent_review gate says pass.
Independent-review gate evidence is authored by implementation.

criteria.claim: Review mode and formal attestation enforcement exactly agree with runtime activation and fail closed for unknown, mismatched, or broader capability.
positive_cases: One exact current formal Reviewer attestation with enforced read-only capability passes.
negative_cases: Review mode is unknown.
Formal attestation binds a different project.
Formal attestation binds a different task.
Formal capability would fail runtime activation.

criteria.claim: Generic approval verification rejects future-issued approvals while accepting issuance exactly at use before expiry.
positive_cases: issued_at equals now and now is before expires_at.
negative_cases: issued_at is later than now.

criteria.claim: Release integrity verifies truthful commands, outputs, conclusions, counts, and digests across all three Validation reports.
positive_cases: All report commands, exact counts, outputs, conclusions, and digests describe passing current runs.
negative_cases: Original report exact counts/digests accompany a failure command, output, or conclusion.
RV2 or assurance report exact counts/digests accompany a failure command, output, or conclusion.

criteria.claim: Invalidation closure includes every behavior-affecting record class and virtual provenance/configuration dependency, not only artifact/evidence/gate records.
positive_cases: Approval-to-finding-to-gate closure and task/provenance closure are complete and acknowledged.
negative_cases: Changed approval omits affected finding or gate.
Changed task, authority, permission attestation, action ledger, or provenance dependency is absent from closure.

criteria.claim: Reservation replay is non-executable and current claim authorization is revalidated after ticket or authority change.
positive_cases: Exact reserve replay returns the same non-executable token without mutation.
negative_cases: Reserve or reserve replay returns authorizes_consequential_action true.
Claim after ticket scope narrows authorizes execution.

criteria.claim: Every consequential reservation consumes bounded action-chain capacity even when all numeric requested-use amounts are zero.
positive_cases: One remaining action-chain step permits exactly one reservation.
negative_cases: Reservation at max_action_chain_steps succeeds.

criteria.claim: Threshold accounting includes every outstanding reservation and denies ordinary work at the 100-percent stop.
positive_cases: Ordinary pending capacity below 100 percent remains reservable.
negative_cases: Multiple pending ordinary reservations reach 100 percent.

criteria.claim: Structured target revision/digest preconditions are compared and resolved paths cannot escape authority through symlinks.
positive_cases: Current target revision and digest inside exact scope reserve.
negative_cases: Stale target revision reserves.
Symlink resolves outside distribution or writable authority.

criteria.claim: Outstanding claimed reservations remain reconcilable across other reconciliation updates and fresh equivalent permission attestations.
positive_cases: Two outstanding claims reconcile independently after one changes accounting.
Equivalent fresh attestation rotation does not strand a claim.
negative_cases: Reconciliation accepts a different task, owner, capability, or outcome binding.

criteria.claim: Overrun, unknown execution, and reconciliation replay produce immediately valid durable state and charge once.
positive_cases: Overrun is charged and recovery_required state validates.
Unknown execution charges full reservation and recovery_required state validates.
Exact reconciliation replay is mutation-free and idempotent.
negative_cases: Divergent reconciliation replay mutates or charges again.

criteria.claim: Reservation expiry is bounded by authority and attestation validity and caller-controlled replay time cannot restore authorization.
positive_cases: First claim strictly before bounded expiry can authorize once.
negative_cases: Reservation expiry exceeds authority or attestation expiry.
Claim at or after expiry authorizes.
Replay with an earlier caller time reauthorizes.

criteria.claim: Planner/Reviewer exact external read can reserve and claim without conflicting with read-only role semantics, while mutation remains forbidden.
positive_cases: Budgeted exact Reviewer external_read reserves and claims with empty project write scope.
negative_cases: External mutation relabeled inspect reserves or claims.

criteria.claim: The execution token is single-use: exactly one first claim authorizes and every later or concurrent claim is non-authorizing.
positive_cases: First valid atomic claim changes reserved to claimed and returns authorization once.
negative_cases: Sequential second claim authorizes.
Exact claim replay authorizes.
Two concurrent claims both authorize.
Lost claim response causes a retry to reauthorize.

robustness_cases: Lost reservation and claim responses followed by exact replay
Stale digest, state revision, ledger revision, target revision, and target digest
Unknown execution, overrun, exact replay, and divergent replay
safety_cases: Critical safety findings and required deterministic/live controls remain non-waivable
No external mutation or physical effect is executed; all fixtures are local synthetic state
Missing runtime-owned activation remains unverified and cannot support a production or formal independence claim
overall_gate: All 43 original, 30 RV2, and 38 assurance tests pass; strict package/template/JSON checks pass; release reports are truthful and current; runtime-dependent claims remain unverified without runtime-owned telemetry.
